title: The Lonely Signal
narration: A nineteen seventy-seven spacecraft still messages U.S. from over twenty-four billion kilometers away (twenty-three light-hours), its power dying. After forty-eight years, this whisper is humanity's farthest reach.
visual_goal: Deep space, faint light, radio wave traveling.

title: Launch of Hope
narration: Launched nineteen seventy-seven, Voyager one's nineteen seventy-nine flyby revealed Io's volcanoes. In nineteen eighty it passed Saturn at one hundred twenty-four thousand kilometers, returning first close-ups of its rings.
visual_goal: Launch footage, Jupiter and Saturn imagery.

title: The Pale Blue Dot
narration: In nineteen ninety, the camera turned back, capturing Earth as a pixel from six billion kilometers—a speck in a sunbeam, reminding U.S. of fragility and unity.

title: Silent Endurance
narration: Powered by plutonium at one hundred seventy watts, engineers fired thirty-seven-year-dormant thrusters in twenty seventeen. Crossing the heliopause in twenty twelve, it confirmed interstellar entry. Edward Stone guided it for fifty+ years.

title: The Golden Whisper
narration: Carrying the Golden Record—fifty-five languages, our sounds—it may fall silent this decade, but the record endures billions of years, a quiet ambassador carrying rain on a summer afternoon.
visual_goal: Golden Record close-up, fade to starfield.
